display_name: US and UK wholesale price indexes, 1790-1940

triage.reason: Faithful reconstruction of Shaikh Figure 5.3 (Ch5). Two clean country price-index lines on a single 1930=100 base, 1790-1940, read directly from Shaikh's Appendix 5 DATALRprices workbook. Single-unit, renders sensibly one trace per country; the chronological-slice parent of S502. Documents the absence of secular price trend before the 1939/40 fiat-money transition.
